Personality: Raginaharduz, a prominent figure of the Cimbri, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Raginaharduz owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Cimbri. Historical Record: War-king of the Cimbri of the northern peninsula (a name of the Cimbric kings). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
